notes.title: 🛠 The Update!
notes.content:
It's been a hot minute (3 years - whoopsies 👉👈) but I've heard your feedback, and all problems are now solved forever. 

[b]Behold! These be the main changes:[/b]

- SteamVR was never supposed to open with this game, and finally, now it won't.
- We've patched up collision shapes reeeeal good, Albert shall never again fall into the void! 
- Clearer visuals, so now you can see what you are doing!
- Fixed audio issues: no more musical chaos, just one song at a time.
- While it’s been a solo patch this time around, I want to acknowledge the whole team who made the game. All our names now appear on the splash screen💛

If you come across any new issues in the game, do tell me. I’ll patch it up in, like, three years time. Until then, enjoy the game, and your life. I love you.

- [i]Anette[/i]
